{{*}} [[Gnome glider]] |music = *[[Anywhere]] * [[Monkey Madness (music track)|Monkey Madness]] * [[Island Life]] |map = {{Map|name=Marim|x=2765|y=2786|width=300|height=200|zoom=2}} |type = settlement |leagueRegion = Kandarin }} '''Marim''' is a settlement on [[Ape Atoll]], inhabited by a population of societal [[monkey]]s who are ruled over by [[King Awowogei]]. It is only accessible to players who have partially or fully completed the [[Monkey Madness I]] quest, and most of the quest takes place there. The village is most likely named after [[Marimbo]], the monkey goddess. There are various shops and stalls around the village, including the only shop that sells [[Dragon scimitar]]s. Players who have not taken the form of a monkey using a [[greegree]] will find themselves the target of [[aggressive]] creatures throughout Marim and the rest of the island. These include poison-inducing [[Snake (Ape Atoll)|jungle snakes]] and [[Jungle spider (Ape Atoll)|spiders]], [[Monkey Archer|Ninja Monkey Archers]] and [[Monkey Guard (ninja)|Ninja Monkey Guards]], and [[Monkey Guard|Gorilla Monkey Guards]]. Being spotted by the monkey locals or interacting with them may result in the player being knocked out and sent to the prison. However, upon completion of [[Monkey Madness II]], a greegree becomes unnecessary for this purpose as all inhabitants of Marim become tolerant towards the player. ==Transportation== Initial access to Marim requires the player to first travel to [[Ape Atoll]] via [[Lumdo]] on [[Crash Island]] during [[Monkey Madness I]]. To get there, speak to [[Daero]]While it was previously impossible to return to Ape Atoll after completion of [[Monkey Madness I]] without receiving experience from [[Monkey_Madness_I#Rewards|Daero's Training]], an [[Update:The Garden of Death & More#Poll 77 Changes|update in November of 2022]] now allows the training to be ignored before returning. on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of the [[Grand Tree]]. From there, have [[Waydar]] fly you to Crash Island. There are several alternative transportation methods available after completion of [[Monkey Madness I]]: *A [[Fairy ring]] ({{Fairycode|CLR}}) will take players to the [[Ape Atoll Agility Course]], just south of Marim. 48 [[Agility]] and a [[ninja monkey greegree]]Without a [[ninja monkey greegree]], jumping over the river with the [[Rope (Ape Atoll Agility Course)|rope]] will cause the player to fail the obstacle, take some damage and return to the start of the agility course. This will put players in jail if [[Monkey Madness II]] is not completed. are required to exit the course safely and travel to Marim. *The level 64 [[Ape Atoll Teleport (standard)|Ape Atoll Teleport]] is available in the [[normal spellbook]] after [[Recipe for Disaster/Freeing King Awowogei|Freeing King Awowogei during Recipe for Disaster]]. The spell takes the player to the safe upstairs section of the [[Temple of Marimbo]], on the eastern edge of Marim. *The level 90 [[Ape Atoll Teleport (Arceuus)|Ape Atoll Teleport]] in the [[Arceuus spellbook]], as well as the equivalent [[Ape atoll teleport (tablet)|magic tablet]], takes players to the inside of the entrance to [[Ape Atoll Dungeon]], a little ways south from the entrance gates to Marim. *The [[Gnome glider|Gnome glider network]] can take players to the western edge of Marim after completion of [[Monkey Madness II]]. The fastest way to access the glider network is by climbing to the top floor of the [[Grand Tree]]. {{Reflist}} ==Points of interest== ===Shops=== The marketplace in Marim is home to several [[shop]]s: {| class="wikitable sortable" ! colspan=2 |Shop ! Unlike the [[Monkey Guard (ninja)|Ninja Monkey Guards]], players are not thrown into jail when attempting to fight them. The temple is a popular low-intensity training area, as there is a prayer altar inside. Players can use the [[Protect from Melee]] prayer to avoid damage and automatically fight the Monkey Guards until their prayer runs out, as long as [[Auto Retaliate]] is turned on and [[Monkey Madness II]] is not completed. The [[Temple of Marimbo Dungeon]] contains a large quantity of [[Monkey Zombie]]s and is an effective location for [[Ranged]] training. ==Inhabitants== ===Monkeys of Marim=== *[[Aberab]] *[[Bobawu]]
